_header: Diego Venegas-Vargas | DAMIC-M collaboration | CCDarkSens Framework -- Example input for utils/migdal_generate_grid.py: generates the Migdal-effect dR/dE_e rates for a silicon target with a light (ultralight) mediator (F_DM ~ 1/q^2) through DarkELF.
_comment: Migdal rate generation config: Si target, light mediator, reduced 150-mass demo grid used by migdal_light_projection_1kgyear.json (DarkELF has no caching, so a denser mass grid is impractically slow -- see Student_Examples_Migdal_Projection.md). Mass range 0.1-1000 MeV covers the 1-35 MeV band DAMIC-M's PRL reports as this channel's most stringent-limit region. Generates dR/dE_e CSVs via darkelf.dRdomega_migdal(). Run: python3 utils/migdal_generate_grid.py configs/examples/migdal_generate_si_light_demo150x200.json
